a.label: Grade 3
a.body: Ask: 'When the sun comes out in the morning, what changes around us?' Let 3-4 pupils share. Write one word from each answer on the board. Open page 13, point to sunrise picture.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body: Ask: 'Have you ever seen a caterpillar on a leaf, or a butterfly near flowers? What did you notice?' Let 3-4 pupils share. Open page 14, point to life-cycle picture.

a.label: Grade 3
a.body:
Teacher: Recite 'Golden Sun' one line at a time with actions. Say 'sun' (short u) and 'shine' (long i). Class claps vowels. Ask: 'Suraj hamein kaun se tohfe deta hai?' Expected: light, life, warmth.
On their own: Read the 5 board-prep words aloud in a whisper. Say 'sun' and 'shine' with partner. Whisper your favourite gift of the sun.
Struggler: Teacher recites one line, student repeats just the last word with the action.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body:
On their own: Look at page 15. Read 'Caterpillar' quietly. Copy words lamb, climb, thumb. Think about caterpillar's colour.
Teacher: Read 'Caterpillar' aloud. Write lamb, climb, thumb — explain silent b. Ask: 'What is the colour of a caterpillar?' Expected: Brown.
Struggler: Teacher points to lamb and says it; student repeats aloud — no writing needed.

a.label: Grade 3
a.body:
Time: min 11-16
Teacher with: Grade 3 — recite 'Golden Sun' with actions, then post-read Q
Grade 3 independent: Copy silent-letter words lamb, climb, thumb from Board Prep
Time: min 16-18
Activity: A Grade 4 buddy reads one line of 'Caterpillar' to a Grade 3 buddy, who claps the rhythm. Swap after 1 min.
Transition cue: Clap twice, say 'G3, apni jagah pakadiye. G4, apni jagah tasveer dekhein.'
Time: min 18-23
Grade 3 independent: Describe the sunset picture in one sentence
Monitor role: Pick one Grade 3 student as Monitor (rotates weekly). During Rotation B: keep Grade 3 on task, point to picture if a child forgets, quietly say 'shabash' when they finish.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body:
Time: min 11-16
Grade 4 independent: Copy silent-letter words lamb, climb, thumb from Board Prep
Time: min 16-18
Activity: A Grade 4 buddy reads one line of 'Caterpillar' to a Grade 3 buddy, who claps the rhythm. Swap after 1 min.
Transition cue: Clap twice, say 'G3, apni jagah pakadiye. G4, apni jagah tasveer dekhein.'
Time: min 18-23
Teacher with: Grade 4 — silent-letter words + echo the 'Caterpillar' poem
Correction tip: If a pair says the b in lamb, gently correct: 'b khamosh hai — laam.'

a.label: Grade 3
a.body:
Timing: Min 23-25: assign tasks · Min 25-27: G3 first · Min 27-30: G4 · Min 30-36: rotate every 90 sec
Need help: Copy 3 words from the board: light, life, warmth.
Standard: 1. Write 3 gifts from the sun. 2. Copy line from 'Golden Sun' and underline the long-vowel word: 'Shine down on me today!'
Challenge: Write one sentence about the sun using the word 'because'.
Extra support: Point to the sun on the board as you name each gift in Urdu · draw the sun and 3 things · circle the correct gift.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body:
Timing: Min 23-25: assign tasks · Min 25-27: G3 first · Min 27-30: G4 · Min 30-36: rotate every 90 sec
Need help: Copy 3 words and circle the silent letter: lamb, climb, thumb.
Standard: 1. Write 4 words with silent letter and circle it. 2. Copy one line from 'Caterpillar' and read aloud to partner.
Challenge: Find and write 2 more words with a silent letter from your own reading.
Extra support: Circle the silent letter in 3 words teacher writes · trace lamb, climb, thumb from dotted template.
Finished early: Did you like the poem? Why? Write one sentence.

a.label: Grade 3
a.body:
Recap: We recited 'Golden Sun'. The sun gives us light, life and warmth. We noticed the long-vowel word 'shine'.
Exit ticket: (a) 'Suraj hamein do tohfe kaun se deta hai?' — Expected: any two of light, life, warmth.
(b) Underline the long-vowel word in: 'Shine down on me today' — Expected: shine.
Homework: Draw the sun and 2 gifts it gives us. Label each in English AND Urdu.

b.label: Grade 4
b.body:
Recap: We read the poem 'Caterpillar' and learned silent letters: the b in lamb, climb and thumb is silent.
Exit ticket: (a) 'Caterpillar nazm ki aik line sunayen — caterpillar kaisa hai?' — Expected: Brown.
(b) Read aloud: lamb, climb, thumb. Kaun sa letter khamosh hai? — Expected: The letter b.
Extra support: Circle the correct answer on the board · point to matching picture · trace on dotted line · draw the answer.
Homework: Find and write 2 more words that have a silent letter.
